تغافلت (form VI)
# تَغَافَلْتُ (taḡāfaltu) /ta.ɣaː.fal.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَغَافَلَ (taḡāfala)
# تَغَافَلْتَ (taḡāfalta) /ta.ɣaː.fal.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَغَافَلَ (taḡāfala)
# تَغَافَلْتِ (taḡāfalti) /ta.ɣaː.fal.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَغَافَلَ (taḡāfala)
# تَغَافَلَتْ (taḡāfalat) /ta.ɣaː.fa.lat/: third-person fem
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
